subsection.name: PT- - Authority to Process Personally Identifiable Information
Data Tagging
description: attach data tags contianing organization defined authorized processing to organization defined elements of personally identifiable information

subsection.name: Automation
description: manage enforcement of the authorized processing of personally identifiable information using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: PT-3 - Personally Identifiable Information Processing Purposes
Data Tagging
description: attafch data tags containing the following purposes to organization defined elements of personally identifiable information: organization defined processing purposes

subsection.name: Automation
description: track processing purposes of personally identifiable infomration using organiztaion defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Tailored Consent
description: provide organization defined mechanisms to allow individuals to tailor processing permissions to selected elements of perosnally identifiable information

subsection.name: Just In Time Consent
description: present organizationn defined consent mechanisms to individuals at organizaiton dfeined frequency and in conjunction with organization defined personally identiifiable information processing

subsection.name: Revocation
description: implement organization defined tools or mechanisms for individuals to revoke consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information

subsection.name: Just In Time Consent
description: present notice of personally identifiable information processing to individuals at a time and location where the individual provides personally identifiable information or in conjunction witha data action or organization defined frequency

subsection.name: Privacy Act Statements
description: include privacy act statements on forms that collect information that will be maintained in a privacy act system of records, or provide privacy act statements on separate forms that can be retained by individuals

subsection.name: Routine Uses
description: review all routine uses published in the system of records notice at organization defined frequency to ensure continued accuracy, and to ensure that routine uses continue to be compatible with the purpose for which the information was collected

subsection.name: Exemption Rules
description: review all privacy act exemption claimed for the system of records at organization defined frequency to ensure they remain appropriate and necessary in accordance with law, that htey have been promulgated as regulations, and that they are accurately described in the system of records notice

subsection.name: PT-7 - Specific Categories of Personally Identifiable Information
Social Security Numbers
description: when a system processes social security numbers
eliminate unnecessary collection, maintenance, and use of social security numbers, and explore alternatives to their use as a personal identifier
do not deny any individual any right, benefit, or privilege provided by law because of such individual's refusal to disclore his or her social security number

inform any individual who is aksed to disclose his or her social security number whether that disclosure is mandatory or voluntary, by what statutory or other authority such number is solicited, and what uses will be made of it

subsection.name: First Amendment Information
description: prohibit the processing of information describing how any individual exercises rights guaranteed by the first amendmetn unless expressly authorized by statute or by the individual or unless pertinent to and within the scope of an authorized law enforcement activity
